profile.status: fixture-declared until the jedit.text@2 lawpack and the authored outcome type are published (#296)
profile.idDerivation: warp and type ids are BLAKE3 over "warp:" or "type:" and the label; BufferId is BLAKE3 over the buffer-key domain and the key
profile.atomCodec: edict.canonical-cbor/v1 map keyed by field name; U64/U8 unsigned, Bytes byte string, String text

rope.height: leaf 1; branch 1 + max(children); AVL: children differ by at most 1
rope.fromBytes: one leaf up to 4096 bytes; otherwise split at the last character boundary at or before half
rope.leafRewrite: an edit inside one leaf whose result is 1-4096 bytes rewrites that leaf and path-copies ancestors
rope.general: otherwise prefix(start), fromBytes(replacement), suffix(end), joined by AVL concatenation
rope.descent: a range descends left while end <= left length, right while start >= left length

profile.validation: a leaf is validated when its atom is decoded; a branch when expanded: edge counts, identity, then its decoded children's checked sums, equality, height and balance, before any child is expanded
profile.readSet: the program's witnessed reads: node records with their atoms, and (source, edge type) ranges, as the specification model resolved them. Echo's own validation and precondition reads are not listed
profile.writeSet: Echo's write set: created node records and atoms, the Buffer atom, created and retargeted edges, and the (source, edge type) range key of each written edge. An Ensure of an existing identical node is not a write
profile.competing: a later check the fixture also fails; verified by re-running the model with the deciding check passed
profile.validationTiming: closure validation covers every node the operation resolves, including those the reconstruction and no-op comparison read; all of it completes before any endpoint is classified
profile.effectOrder: Echo canonical order: node record, then attachment, then edge; then local id bytes
